digest.component_or_area: Outbound sync dispatcher and cross-project validation
propositions: Outbound create mutations must resolve their target project from the ticket's bridge_project field against the store mapping, rather than using a single construction-time project value, to support multi-project dispatch.
The cross-project guard must validate that update/delete targets belong to any project in the store's configured set, not just equality against a single project.

The resolved target project must be stamped into the create mutation as _bridge_target_project in mutation fields, read by both Cloud and DC transports, with DC explicitly dropping it before sending to Jira.
A ticket whose resolved project is absent from the mapping set must produce no create mutation, closing the gap in the create path that the guard cannot catch.
Single-project stores with no mapping must preserve backward-compatible behavior by falling back to the configured project default.
